stories.headline: Hilaria Baldwin flaunts fit figure in bikini as fans marvel at mom of 7 - Fox News
stories.summary: Hilaria Baldwin demonstrated glute exercises in a bikini video on Instagram, earning praise from fans amazed by the mother of seven's fit physique.
stories.why: She's redefining what postpartum looks like for wealthy Gen X men's wives—the bikini content signals unrealistic fitness standards are now a flex of privilege and discipline, not just genetics.

stories.headline: Nickelodeon child actor crashes out, reveals bleak reality of residual checks from sitcom - Fox News
stories.summary: Jennifer Hyatt Tedmori opened her stack of residual checks from "Ned's Declassified School Survival Guide" on video, revealing shockingly low payouts.
stories.why: This is a cautionary tale for anyone who let their kids pursue acting: residuals from a hit show are basically nothing, exposing how the entertainment industry extracts value from child labor.

stories.headline: D4vd Apple Music Account Hacked, Fake Song Posted Amid Preliminary Hearing - TMZ
stories.summary: Amid singer D4vd being locked up and currently fighting to keep his murder case from going to trial, his Apple Music page has been hacked ... posting a fake song with a voice sounding like the jailed…
stories.why: A cautionary tale about digital security and a dark reminder that being arrested for murder doesn't stop your career machinery—his accounts keep working even when he can't.

stories.headline: Charli XCX Releases Music, Fashion, Film B-Sides - Pitchfork
stories.summary: All three songs come with their own black-and-white music videos
stories.why: She's cementing her position as the most culturally tuned artist of her generation by treating music as one output in a multimedia creative practice, not the main event.

stories.headline: Seven-Time ‘Jeopardy!’ Champion Courtney Shah Dies At 52 - Deadline
stories.summary: Courtney Shah, the Jeopardy winner who went on to compete in the show's Tournament of Champions, died at home on Tuesday after a battle with brain cancer.
stories.why: The loss of a seven-time champion reminds you that being brilliant at trivia doesn't protect you from mortality—intelligence and achievement don't equal invincibility.

stories.headline: Tom Holland Says Some of His Movies Are “Sh**,” Making Them Hard to Promote - The Hollywood Reporter
stories.summary: However, he's been "absolutely loving" his press tours for 'The Odyssey' and 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day.'
stories.why: He's being refreshingly honest about the dirty secret of Hollywood: sometimes you're asked to promote movies you don't believe in, and the lie is getting harder to maintain.

stories.headline: First teaser for Apple TV’s Neuromancer debuts at SDCC - Ars Technica
stories.summary: Plus Mike Flanagan's Carrie teaser, trailers for Dark Matter S2 and Matchbox the Movie, and Marvel news.
stories.why: Neuromancer becoming prestige TV signals that cyberpunk's 1984 predictions are finally resonating with mainstream audiences as present-day reality, not sci-fi fantasy.
